scope: Relocation compilation only; recorded performance belongs to original sealed binaries/capsules, not a new performance claim
git_bytes_policy: Package-scoped -text preserves frozen source/rawCSV bytes. cr-at-eol applies only to CSV whitespace display; numerical/identity gates unchanged. Without it Git EOL normalization would invalidate archived SHA256.
frozen_source_whitespace_policy: Only source/** is exempt from cosmetic Git whitespace diagnostics because these are byte-identical snapshots, including existing EOF/trailing whitespace. README/tools remain checked. SHA256/native-source/CSV/report/commit checks are unchanged; no numerical or performance gate is relaxed.
